description: Source code implementing custom memory allocation functions for Skia graphics library, including handling of malloc, calloc, realloc, and out-of-memory scenarios.

methods.name: throw_on_failure
methods.description: Handles failure in memory allocation, calls sk_out_of_memory() if allocation fails.

methods.name: sk_abort_no_print
methods.description: Aborts execution without printing, uses linker aliasing to prevent merging.

methods.name: sk_realloc_throw
methods.description: Reallocates memory with exception on failure, handles zero size case.

methods.name: sk_free
methods.description: Frees allocated memory if pointer is not null.

methods.name: prevent_overcommit
methods.description: Touches memory to prevent overcommitting, fills memory with a byte.

methods.name: malloc_throw
methods.description: Allocates memory with throw on failure, uses prevent_overcommit.

methods.name: malloc_nothrow
methods.description: Allocates memory without throwing exceptions, uses base::UncheckedMalloc.

methods.name: calloc_throw
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory with throw on failure.

methods.name: calloc_nothrow
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory without throwing exceptions.

methods.name: sk_malloc_flags
methods.description: Allocates memory based on flags for zero-initialization and throw behavior.
